LESSON: WRITING WRITING

Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.3: Writing WRITING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing WRITING. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: where they turn pages from right to left as books when writing?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Writing WRITING
2. Give Kenyan examples for Writing WRITING
3. Practise Writing WRITING at school and at home

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW
